papers.title: Are Nonagenarians Too Old For Total Hip Arthroplasty? An Evaluation of Morbidity and Mortality Within a Total Joint Replacement Registry
papers.first_author_affiliation: Southern California Permanente Medical Group, Los Angeles Medical Center

corresponding_authors.name: Alexander Miric
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Southern California Permanente Medical Group, Los Angeles Medical Center

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文仅关注高龄患者全髋关节置换术后的发病率和死亡率，未涉及任何生物力学建模或植入物设计。
llm.why_not_core: This paper is a clinical outcomes study with no biomechanical modeling, no FEA, no stress shielding or micromotion analysis, and no implant design or contact mechanics.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估90岁以上患者行全髋关节置换术的风险。
summary_zh.method: 回顾性分析关节置换登记数据，比较非高龄与高龄患者并发症。
summary_zh.result: 非高龄患者术后并发症和死亡率可接受。
summary_zh.validation: 基于临床登记数据的统计分析。

summary_en.motivation: To evaluate whether nonagenarians face higher morbidity and mortality after total hip arthroplasty compared to younger patients.
summary_en.method: Retrospective analysis of a total joint replacement registry comparing complication rates and mortality between nonagenarians and younger cohorts.
summary_en.result: Nonagenarians had acceptable complication and mortality rates, suggesting age alone should not contraindicate THA.
summary_en.validation: Statistical analysis of registry data with propensity matching.

papers.title: Bacterial Contamination in Tips of Electrocautery Devices During Total Hip Arthroplasty
papers.first_author_affiliation: Rothman Institute at Thomas Jefferson University, Philadelphia, Pennsylvania

corresponding_authors.name: Alisina Shahi
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Rothman Institute at Thomas Jefferson University, Philadelphia, Pennsylvania

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究全髋关节置换术中电刀头细菌污染，与股骨假体应力遮挡或微动分析无关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on bacterial contamination of surgical instruments, not on biomechanics, stress shielding, micromotion, or implant design.

summary_zh.motivation: 评估全髋关节置换术中电刀头细菌污染情况。
summary_zh.method: 术中收集电刀头进行细菌培养。
summary_zh.result: 发现一定比例的电刀头存在细菌污染。

summary_en.motivation: To assess the prevalence of bacterial contamination on electrocautery tips during total hip arthroplasty.
summary_en.method: Electrocautery tips were collected intraoperatively and subjected to bacterial culture.
summary_en.result: A proportion of electrocautery tips were found to be contaminated with bacteria.

papers.title: Novel Active Learning Experiences for Students to Identify Barriers to Independent Living for People with Disabilities
papers.abstract: PURPOSE: This article describes interactive learning about independent living for people with disabilities and features the partnership of the College of Nursing and a Center for Independent Living (CIL). DESIGN: Using qualitative descriptive approach, students' written reflections were analyzed. METHODS: Through "Xtreme Challenge," 82 undergraduate nursing students participated in aspects of independent living as well as identifying barriers. FINDINGS: Students were engaged and learned to consider the person before the disability. Moreover, students valued the activity leaders' openness, which facilitated understanding the point of view of a person with disability. CONCLUSIONS: The value of partnership was evident as it allowed students to participate in active learning, which led to growth in the affective domain. Students became aware of potential education resources through the CIL. CLINICAL RELEVANCE: This article will guide educators in designing experiences that teach nursing care at the individual, family, and community level for people living with disabilities.

summary_zh.motivation: 描述护理学生通过体验式学习了解残疾人独立生活障碍。
summary_zh.method: 采用定性描述方法分析学生反思。
summary_zh.result: 学生增强了以人为先的意识，并认识到独立生活中心的资源。
summary_zh.validation: 基于学生书面反思的定性分析。

summary_en.motivation: To describe an interactive learning experience for nursing students to understand barriers to independent living for people with disabilities.
summary_en.method: A qualitative descriptive approach was used to analyze students' written reflections after participating in an 'Xtreme Challenge' activity.
summary_en.result: Students learned to consider the person before the disability and valued the openness of activity leaders.
